hints.content: Imagine that the plane slices the solid figure.  The slice cuts through the tent vertically and the direction of the cut is parallel to the front of the tent.
The front of the tent (where the zipper is) has the shape of an equilateral triangle.

The shape of a vertical intersection with the tent is an equilateral triangle.   


[[☃ image 1]]

question.content:
You're out on a camping trip, and you're thinking about the geometry of your tent.  It resembles a triangular prism.



[[☃ image 1]]

**Which shape does the intersection of the vertical plane with the tent look like?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

options.alt: A triangular prism with a rectangle through it that represents the cross-section. The rectangle is at an angle so that it is parallel to a base of the triangular prism. The rectangle moves through the entire triangular prism showing every possible cross-section. It cross-section includes an equilateral triangle.
